div.style: position: fixed; top: 480px; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); -webkit-transform: translate(-50%, -50%); opacity: 0.25; z-index: -1000; text-align: center; pointer-events: none;

span.t-attf-style: display: inline-block; transform: rotate(-{{company.rotating_angle or 0}}deg); -webkit-transform: rotate(-{{company.rotating_angle or 0}}deg); color: {{company.color_picker or '#000000'}}; font-size: {{company.font_size or 20}}px; font-weight: bold; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.2;

img.t-attf-style: max-height: 400px; max-width: 500px; object-fit: contain; transform: rotate(-{{company.rotating_angle or 0}}deg); -webkit-transform: rotate(-{{company.rotating_angle or 0}}deg);
